newsitem.title: UK: IPE GAS OIL SEEN $1.50 LOWER, BRENT NERVOUS ON IRAQ.
newsitem.headline: IPE GAS OIL SEEN $1.50 LOWER, BRENT NERVOUS ON IRAQ.

text.p: IPE gas oil was expected to open lower on Thursday to catch up with Brent crude which sank in late trade as oil companies lined up to take delivery of the first Iraqi exports since late May.
Aug gas oil, which ended at $175.25 a tonne, should open about $1.50 lower while Sept Brent crude is expected to begin the day unchanged to five cents below its $19.20 settlement.

Brokers said the market would remain on tenterhooks waiting for a clearer indication of how much Baghdad intends to export before the first half of the 180-day oil-for-food deal expires on September 5.
